title: The Collection Call
description: An unknown number appears. He picks up — the voice on the other end is low and calm. "Mr. Kim Minjun, I'm someone who helped you out briefly a while back. I think it's time we settled up." He has no memory of borrowing anything, but this person knows far too much about him.

choices.text: Tell them they have the wrong person and hang up
choices.result_text: He hangs up, but the calls keep coming. Same number, same voice. He blocks it — a different number calls. Something gave this person his number.

choices.text: Ask how they got his contact information
choices.result_text: "Someone who knows you passed it along." They won't say who. They'll call back in four weeks, they say. Think it over until then.

The man at the café was neat and composed. He slid a sheet of paper across the table. The signature date looks like his handwriting, but he has no memory of it. He paid 200,000 won and got out of there.

title: That Someone
description: After four weeks, the call comes again. This time they say a name. It's a name he knows. Someone he once asked for a favor. Or someone he once turned his back on.

choices.text: Deny knowing anyone by that name
choices.result_text: The caller laughed quietly. "If you don't know them, there's nothing I can do either." The line went dead. Now he can't reach out to that person.
"I had no choice. I'm sorry." He handed over 300,000 won to make it go away. The relationship survived, but something shifted.

title: The Rumor
description: A KakaoTalk message from an acquaintance. "Minjun, are you aware there's some weird rumor going around about you?" He asks what kind — they say they're not sure. Somewhere out there, his reputation is being rewritten.

choices.text: Ignore it. No bandwidth to deal with this
choices.result_text: Two weeks later, the interviewer at a job interview treated him with a strange edge. No offer came. The rumor had already spread.
He worked through mutual contacts one by one. Someone definitely leaked it — but it looks like it'll take another five weeks to pin down who.

choices.text: Flip the rumor to his advantage
choices.result_text: "Heard the rumor? I'm working on something big these days — guess I made some enemies." He laughed it off, and people actually bought it. Bluff or boldness — hard to say.

title: The Source
description: He finally found them. It was someone he never would have guessed. Someone he'd known for a long time, someone he'd shared meals with. He doesn't understand why they did it. Or maybe, somewhere in the back of his mind, he does.

choices.result_text: Their face went red. First denial, then admission. The reason was envy. The relationship is over, but strangely — he feels lighter.

choices.text: Say nothing and quietly drift away
choices.result_text: They must have sensed it — the messages thinned out. He learned again how people get quietly removed from your life.

choices.text: Pretend he doesn't know and keep seeing them
choices.result_text: Knowing but acting like you don't is harder than it sounds. But he still needed the connections this person had.

title: An Old Promise
description: A DM arrives out of nowhere. "Hey, remember when we said we'd start something together? I'm actually ready now. What about you?" He remembers. He'd just been talking — but apparently the other person had been waiting in earnest.

choices.text: Be honest — tell them things have changed on his end
choices.result_text: {name} wrote that things had changed and he could not keep the promise to start together, then pressed send. Only a sent time remained beneath his bubble. No read receipt, reply, or confirmation that the relationship had ended appeared.

choices.text: Stall — tell them the timing isn't right yet
choices.result_text: {name} wrote that he could not settle the answer now and would send his own decision within seven weeks. Only a sent time remained on the screen. No reply or promise to wait appeared.

{name} sent a proposal to try it together and named the first draft he would prepare. He set aside 500,000 won on his side for that preparation, but no read receipt, reply, agreement, or weekend meeting appeared. Proposing a start was not the same fact as starting together.

title: Seven Weeks Later: My Deadline
description:
A calendar reminder {name} had set seven weeks earlier appeared. The old DM still showed only his message and its sent time. With no read receipt or reply, he could not know whether the other person had waited or already left.

The only fact {name} could verify was that the date he had promised on his side was today.

choices.text: Send the one-page draft I will own and a cap on preparation costs
choices.result_text:
{name} sent the one-page draft he would own and a ceiling for preparation costs. He set aside 300,000 won of his own in the preparation account.

Only a sent time appeared. There was no read receipt, reply, or agreement. Preparing his part was not the same fact as the two of them starting a collaboration.

choices.text: On the date I promised, send that I cannot take it further
choices.result_text:
{name} did not postpone the date again. He wrote that he could not start something together and pressed send. Only the sent time remained beneath his bubble.

No read receipt, reply, or verdict on the relationship appeared. The only fact he could verify was that he had ended his own delay today.
